app_fee.value: No upfront PhD application fee is stated on Leiden's central PhD track admission pages, PhD Regulations 2026, Protocol for PhD Programmes 2026, or Graduate School of Science pages (employed PhDs apply to salaried vacancies; scholarship-provider, bench, or annual supervision fees may apply after admission for non-employed PhD tracks).

fee_waiver.value: No PhD application fee waiver policy is stated on Leiden's central PhD or Graduate School of Science pages.

gre_general.value: No GRE requirement is stated in Leiden's PhD Regulations 2026, Protocol for PhD Programmes 2026, or Graduate School of Science PhD pages.

toefl_min.value: No university-wide TOEFL minimum is set for PhD admission; the 2026 Protocol states that individual institutes/faculties may set language requirements, and the Graduate School of Science states no score cutoff.
toefl_min.quote: Institutes/faculties may impose additional requirements, such as a language requirement for international PhD candidates.

ielts_min.value: No university-wide IELTS minimum is set for PhD admission; the 2026 Protocol states that individual institutes/faculties may set language requirements, and the Graduate School of Science states no score cutoff.
ielts_min.quote: Institutes/faculties may impose additional requirements, such as a language requirement for international PhD candidates.

english_waiver.value: Language requirements for PhD candidates are delegated to individual institutes/faculties; no university-wide or Graduate School of Science exemption rule for Indian English-medium degrees is stated.
english_waiver.quote: Institutes/faculties may impose additional requirements, such as a language requirement for international PhD candidates.

notes: Most Leiden STEM PhD candidates apply to salaried job vacancies and register via LUCRIS GSM through their faculty Graduate School after securing supervisor agreement. Checked central Studying for a PhD page, Admission to a PhD track page, PhD Regulations 2026 PDF, Protocol for PhD Programmes 2026 PDF, and Graduate School of Science PhD pages.
